title: Hong Kong Daily Press 1876-03-21
summary: A BRITISH SEAMAN ORDERED TO BE FLOGGED. JACK ON SHORE. SUNDAY'S GALE. UNLAWFUL POSSESSION. BREACH OF THE BUILDING ORDINANCE. LARCENY. DOCTOR PUNG CHAI KIN. REPAIRING A GRAVE. THE JAPANESE IN COREA.- NATIVE ACCOUNTS OF THEIR RECEPTION. PRESIDENTIAL PROGNOSTICATIONS. THE CHICAGO "TIMES" PRESIDENTIAL NOMINATION. THE "HARVEST QUEEN" COLLISION. DEATH OF REVERDY JOHNSON. FUNERAL OF REVERDY JOHNSON. MARI
